Visible unoccupied ground squares within 5 squares, joined along their edges. Make a Knowledge roll and cover up to 3/5/7 connected squares on Weak/Standard/Strong with ice. The area is difficult terrain until the end of your next turn. The first time an enemy enters one of its squares during a turn, it gains Slowed 1. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain the area until the end of your next turn.
